title: Event envelope
description: Every event published by the exchange has this shape; payload is the type-specific body described by the sibling schema named after event_type. Fields are only ever added: a change in meaning bumps schema_version and adds a new file (docs/events.md).

event_id.description: ULID, unique per event. Consumers deduplicate on it.

event_type.description: <domain>.<type>; neither part contains a dot, so it maps onto the NATS subject.

market_id.description: Market symbol for market-domain events, null otherwise.

account_id.description: Account the event belongs to, null for market-only events.

seq.description: Per-market engine sequence. Order market-domain events by this, never by arrival.

account_seq.description: Per-account sequence. Order account-domain events by this; a gap means events were missed.
